posts.caption: Our little miracle is finally here 💙 Baby James, 6lbs 4oz, born at Southmead Hospital. We are so in love. #newborn #blessed #southmeadhospital
posts.imageDescription: A newborn baby in a hospital crib, medical equipment visible in background, NHS branding on the wall

posts.caption: First trip to the park! James loved the sunshine ☀️ St Andrews Park is our favourite spot
posts.imageDescription: Baby in a pram in a park, street signs visible, residential houses in background

posts.caption: Tough week. James has been wheezing again, back to the GP tomorrow. The doctor thinks it might be early signs of asthma. Fingers crossed it's nothing serious 🤞
Our Valentine 💕 This little boy is our whole world. Can't believe he's almost 1!
posts.imageDescription: Baby sitting in a living room, modest furnishings visible, small terraced house interior

posts.caption: Staycation this year but James doesn't mind! Weston-super-Mare with Nana. No complaints from us 🌊
posts.imageDescription: Toddler on a beach, UK seaside town visible in background

posts.caption: Had to pick James up early from nursery again today. His inhaler is basically a permanent fixture now. Poor love, asthma is no joke in winter 😔 #asthma #toddlerlife
Big news! Mark got made redundant last week. Scary times but we'll get through it. Proud of how calm he's been. James keeps us smiling through everything 💙
First day at St Mary's Primary! Can't believe my baby is in reception already 😭 So proud of you James. Mrs Thompson's class here we come! #firstdayofschool #stmarysbristol
posts.imageDescription: Small child in school uniform outside school gates, St Mary's Primary School sign visible

posts.caption: Parent's evening tonight. Teacher says James is struggling to sit still and focus. She mentioned ADHD assessment might be worth exploring. Lots to think about 😟
ADHD assessment confirmed today. Part of me is relieved we finally have answers. It's been a long road. James is perfect just the way he is 💙 #ADHD #ADHDmum #neurodivergent
Managed a long weekend in Tenerife! First proper holiday since before James was born. Needed this so much 🌞
posts.imageDescription: Child on a budget hotel balcony, basic pool visible below, budget airline luggage tags visible

posts.caption: Mark starts his new job Monday! What a relief. It's been 18 months and honestly it's taken its toll on all of us. Fresh start 🙏

James had another meltdown at school today. The ADHD meds help but some days are just really hard. Being a special needs mum is the hardest and most rewarding thing I've ever done 💙 #ADHDparenting #meltdown
End of Year 2! James has come so far this year. So proud of this boy despite everything 💙
posts.imageDescription: Child holding school report outside terraced house, same house as earlier posts visible
